evidence_refs.quote: consumers must preserve the canonical terms and negative constraints defined here.

observations.statement: Platform naming is closed: Puppet Master is the only product name and legacy naming is the only permitted reference to older names.

evidence_refs.quote: - **Puppet Master** -- the only correct platform name. - **legacy naming** -- the only allowed way to refer to older platform naming.

observations.statement: Runtime routing fixes three behaviors: bare /web is help-only; provider_unavailable falls through eligible providers before exposing recovery guidance; browser handoff pauses and resumes from a precise step or explicit retry.

evidence_refs.quote: Bare `/web` opens help/autocomplete and performs no default web operation.

resumes only from the paused step pointer or an explicit retry of the current repro step

observations.statement: Remote projection UI separates freshness, health, and write availability; under-specified commands block mutation, and action gating considers freshness and health together.

any under-specified command must block mutation until these fields are known.

The only combination rule says conditions can block, without mapping either enum set or defining which combinations must block each action.

candidate_findings.obligation: Click, hover, and state, badge, or field help affordances need deterministic criteria for selecting inline help, context help, or canonical-entry navigation.
candidate_findings.gap: The text says help-linking decides among three destinations and canonical navigation applies when local explanation is insufficient, but it never defines insufficiency, density thresholds, click-versus-hover behavior, or fallback when a richer entry is absent.

candidate_findings.summary: Escalation and resurfacing are declared deterministic but omit transitions and make dismissal semantics unsafe.
candidate_findings.obligation: The ladder and aging rules need trigger predicates, timing thresholds, state transitions, owner-reassignment behavior, and a rule preserving active-blocker truth after presentation dismissal.
candidate_findings.gap: No thresholds or transition criteria are supplied. Resurfacing stops when a blocker is dismissed even though dismissal is explicitly not semantic resolution and active blockers must not become fake health; continued attention and resurfacing for a still-active dismissed blocker are undefined.

candidate_findings.summary: SparseNgramIndex leaves correctness-critical extraction behavior undefined.
candidate_findings.obligation: Transparent candidate narrowing needs exact normalization, sparse-n-gram parameters, minimal-cover selection, unsupported-pattern fallback, and snapshot publication/failure semantics sufficient to guarantee that no matching file is omitted before ripgrep verification.
candidate_findings.gap: The capsule says build extracts all sparse n-grams and query extracts a minimal-covering set but defines neither term nor the fallback boundary. Because ripgrep verifies only narrowed candidates, implementations can diverge in false-negative behavior despite the final-correctness claim.

evidence_refs.quote: Build time extracts all sparse n-grams from normalized content; query time extracts only a minimal-covering set.
